interface_authority: Actual registered source/runtime and describe_engine take precedence over latest public documentation. Parameters must map to emitted config/API/CLI; no invented effective controls.

zh-CN.fallback: Registered ASE version/API and AIMatterLab bilingual recipe rules

zh-CN: 采用ASE真实bulk/molecule/surface或显式结构参数，来源、晶格常数、cell/PBC和原子顺序都要可核查。
结构检查不等于能量弛豫或势模型适用性；温度、系综和反应坐标不能仅从几何推断。
实际文件与哈希由工具保存回读，展示真实结构帧和测量/提案来源。
en: Use actual bulk/molecule/surface/read/write parameters allowed by the AIMatterLab recipe schema.
Source bulk/molecule defaults are construction proposals; inspect serialized structure/PBC/cell/overlap and element order.
A generated geometry or EMT toy test is not a validated production potential or material model.

display_policy.basic: System/task-dependent scientific choices and consequential unresolved decisions first. Preserve upstream parameter names.
display_policy.details: Group actual defaults and technical values by purpose in folded sections, retaining source/proposed/derived provenance.
display_policy.execution: Saved inputs and completeness are distinct from artifact/runtime/numerical/physical validation. Current user delegation and existing project/resource authorization govern execution; required serialized-artifact and target-runtime checks remain separate.

copyright: AIMatterLab-authored concise rules. Official tutorial links and source references retain their own licenses; raw mirrored manuals are not part of this public reference.

local_files.read_scope: Whole-file byte identity verified. Ranges locate supporting source; rule assertions remain limited to reviewed symbols, not a full source audit or runtime execution.

local_files.observed_source: development working tree, identified by whole-file SHA-256
local_files.read_scope: Whole-file byte identity verified. Ranges locate supporting source; rule assertions remain limited to reviewed symbols, not a full source audit or runtime execution.

applicability.source_match: Only for the identified source_id and exact selected source-file hashes. Git commit alone is insufficient when files are dirty.
applicability.on_source_mismatch: Mark stale; conceptual reference only. Read the actual parser/catalog before proposing or emitting config.
applicability.selected_runtime: Executable/module capability is NOT verified by this document. Use selected registered runtime probe, exact executable/module identities and consumer validation.
applicability.web: Captured primary documentation is a reference; it cannot overwrite local fork semantics.
applicability.installation: No grant, install, branch change or submission is authorized by this reference. Do not attach install bodies on normal calculation turns.
applicability.science: No convergence, physical validity, safe production defaults or artifact compatibility is established by this source receipt.

source_receipt.language_policy: Rule summaries are AIMatterLab-authored CN/EN. Do not claim unavailable official Chinese manuals.

parameter_emission_policy.keys: Planning labels are not automatically valid config keywords. Serialize only the actual matched parser/API schema.
parameter_emission_policy.defaults: Listed source defaults are annotated observations/proposals, not automatic scientific recommendations.
